name: magpie-doubao-work-auth
description: 豆荚：把豆包工作（Doubao Work）的订阅积分变成 magpie 网关上的模型，供其他 Agent 使用

summary.en: Doubao Work subscription as magpie models. Sign in by pasting a cookie, from a local browser, or from the desktop client; every model in the account's menu becomes available, with real quota and daily check-in.
summary.zh: 把豆包工作订阅变成 magpie 的模型。粘贴 Cookie、读本机浏览器或读桌面客户端都能登录，账号模型菜单里的全部模型（豆包 / DeepSeek / Kimi / GLM 等）都能用，并汇报真实积分与每日签到。
